first_backend_slice.goal: Authorised client reads own conversations, opens one thread, sends one text message, receives authoritative snapshot and retries safely.
backend_owner_must_define: authenticated principal and conversation access policy
message submit endpoint with client-generated idempotency key
server states for pending, accepted, delivered, read, rejected and retryable failure
idempotency retention, conflict and timeout outcome
attachment policy and upload lifecycle before exposing attachment action
audit/actor timestamps and server-assigned message identifiers
required_contract_tests: unauthorised and foreign-conversation access is denied without data leak
same idempotency key produces exactly one persisted message
timeout/retry resolves the original request without a duplicate
reload returns the authoritative persisted snapshot
server rejection remains an error state and never renders delivered
five-width visual smoke retains the source composition

deferred_contracts: credits, checkout, payment and balance mutation
paid-session lifecycle, timer, rate, ledger, start/end and debits
delivery/read receipts beyond the first authoritative message contract
g50 media source, player and lifecycle
forbidden_shortcuts: localStorage or fixture data as backend truth
client timer or balance calculation as billing authority
replay of a possibly accepted mutation without idempotency reconciliation
